Every pair must use at least 20% fewer hardware instructions on C; two-sided exact paired sign p <=0.05; paired median and exact median interval [min,max] with 96.875% coverage for n=6. Further warm repetitions are within-host controls. Genuine edit must save work on every host. Old and independent clean result must each stay within 2% of parent on each boot.
